about: The heading of a Gospel reading from Saint Mark. Sequéntia means the continuation: the passage is read from the course of the Gospel, not from its opening verses. The 1962 Roman Missal prints it over the Gospels of Easter Sunday, of the Ascension of the Lord and of the 6th and 11th Sundays after Pentecost.

s01.translation: The continuation of the holy Gospel according to Mark
